SELECT s.store_id >= 900 AS pseudo, s.store_id IN (900,999) AS ps2, f.channel_code, f.vat_rate, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, count(*) n, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(round(f.net_amount*f.vat_rate,2)) calc_vat, sum(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount) vat, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount-f.net_amount-f.net_amount*f.vat_rate)>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ALL

SELECT 'dup_receipt_line' chk, count(*) n, 0 x FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'rate_by_date_'||f.vat_rate::VARCHAR, count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND f.vat_rate IN (0.24,0.255) AND ((f.vat_rate=0.24 AND f.sale_date>=DATE '2024-09-01') OR (f.vat_rate=0.255 AND f.sale_date<DATE '2024-09-01')) GROUP BY f.vat_rate
UNION ALL SELECT 'store_key_outside_validity', count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (f.sale_date<s.valid_from OR f.sale_date>s.valid_to)
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_overlap', count(*), 0 FROM stg_sales_line_load WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_ids_also_in_fact', count(*), 0 FROM stg_sales_line_load t WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=t.sales_line_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'vat_class_vs_rate_mismatch', count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND ((p.vat_class='reduced10' AND f.vat_rate<>0.10) OR (p.vat_class='reduced14' AND f.vat_rate<>0.14) OR (p.vat_class='standard' AND f.vat_rate NOT IN (0.24,0.255)))
UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_or_null', count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND (f.net_amount<=0 OR f.net_amount IS NULL OR f.quantity<=0)
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_date_trading_non_trading_sales_stores', count(*), 0 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-26' AND DATE '2024-09-22' AND s.store_id<900 AND NOT d.is_trading_day

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, f.vat_rate * 100 AS vat_rate_pct, sum(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount) AS vat_charged_eur
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND f.channel_code = 'ST' AND s.store_id < 900
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY f.vat_rate
